description: Cron expression–based trigger adapter. Polls on scheduler interval and fires when cron expression matches current time. Mirrors engine/runtime/scheduler.py::CronTriggerAdapter.
instructions: Configured with a cron expression (standard 5-field format), a TaskSubmission template, and a name.
On each poll, check if the cron expression matches the current time (within tolerance).
If matched, return a dispatch containing the TaskSubmission template.
Avoid double-firing within the same minute window.
